messages:
ellen: Noticed the Next starter's eval harness shows different latency numbers than Console for streamed responses. Might be telemetry instrumentation mismatch between SDK and sample app.

maria: Can you share repro? is this happening in hosted or local dev?

ellen: Local dev. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-eval (branch: telemetry-quirk). Steps: pnpm dev, run /eval, hit the streamed chat test. Eval harness reports median token latency ~30ms/token but Console trace shows ~60ms/token.

ben: could be double-wrapping the SDK timing or counting network + processing differently. Do we measure from handshake vs first token?

ellen: Eval harness uses perf.now() around redwood.chat.stream() and measures per-token time in the stream handler. Console uses server-side span measured at runtime before sending chunks. So sources differ.

kai: what about client-side buffering? browser stream might batch small chunks; our client handler emits tokens in bursts which makes per-token timing look better. The server sees actual generation time.

maria: good point. can you paste the client stream handler?

ellen: snippet: 
```js
const stream = await redwood.chat.stream(...)
for await (const token of stream) {
  const t = performance.now();
  // count tokens/time here
}
```

ben: SDK emits tokens when NDJSON parsed; if the client concatenates bytes before parsing it could make tokens appear faster. Also check DevTools: network waterfall shows chunk spacing.

ellen: I instrumented with fetch-level logging and the server chunks arrive spaced like Console. The client-side handler is emitting immediately, so harness is effectively attributing server inter-chunk time to parsing/emit time.

kai: actionable: add a small guard in the sample eval harness to compute latency based on server-provided timestamps when present (we attach chunk ts header) or use first-byte timestamps from network layer. That will align with Console.

maria: we'll add a note in the sample README explaining telemetry differences and include a small patch to the harness that uses server chunk headers if available. Also file SDK issue to standardize token-level timestamps across SDKs.

ci-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4333 "Eval harness vs Console token latency mismatch (streaming telemetry)" (assignee: kai).

ellen: PR incoming to sample that adds harness fix + README note. thanks all.
